gbm_population_evidence.quote: Parts B and C: Previous histopathologically confirmed diagnosis of glioblastoma and radiographic evidence of recurrence after prior therapy with radiotherapy.

candidate_evidence.quote: 5-ALA will be administered as a sonosensitizer prior to CV01-delivered ultrasound and will be re-administered every 4 weeks prior to CV01 ultrasound delivery.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Part A: Previous histopathologically confirmed diagnosis of high-grade glioma and radiographic evidence of recurrence after prior therapy with radiotherapy.

role_evidence.quote: 5-ALA will be administered as a sonosensitizer prior to CV01-delivered ultrasound and will be re-administered every 4 weeks prior to CV01 ultrasound delivery.
The CV01 device will deliver non-ablative, low-intensity ultrasound to deep regions of the brain to induce apoptosis of cancer cells.

agents.drug_class_hint: oral sonosensitizer (5-ALA HCl; Gleolan) for sonodynamic therapy
agents.stated_antitumour_mechanism: sonosensitizer activated by low-intensity ultrasound to induce apoptosis of cancer cells

coder_notes: Sonodynamic therapy: 5-ALA is the antitumour sonosensitizer (not fluorescence-guided resection), so candidate with device_dependent true. Part A includes grade 3/4 astrocytoma and grade 3 oligodendroglioma; Parts B and C restricted to glioblastoma at first recurrence. Keywords mention glioblastoma but eligibility names it, so mixed_glioma_gbm_named.
